name: Public Health Birth Data: Birth and Fertility
attribution: Cook County Department of Public Health

Department.Publishing Department: Cook County Department of Public Health

Detailed Descriptive.Data notes: Source data does not differentiate between gender and sex assigned at birth. For clarity and brevity, metadata descriptions reflect gendered language with the understanding that these descriptions may not accurately reflect all cases.
Detailed Descriptive.Geographic coverage: Cook County without City of Chicago

columns.name: Place
columns.description: Municipality or area the birth took place. CCDPH jurisdiction refers to all Cook County municipalities except Chicago, Evanston, Skokie, Oak Park, Forest View, Burbank, and (incorporated) Stickney. See the attached district map for more information.

columns.name: Race and Ethnicity
columns.description: Race and ethnicity of mother. "NH" refers to "non-Hispanic".

columns.name: Count of Crude Birth
columns.description: Total number of births in the total population of a specified group. This data is only available for the "All Ages" age group.

columns.name: Rate of Crude Birth
columns.description: Number of births per 1,000 population in specified group. This data is only available for the "All Ages" age group.

columns.name: Count of Fertility
columns.description: Total number of births to women between the ages of 15 to 44 in a specified group. This data is only available for the "15 to 44" age group.

columns.name: Rate of Fertility
columns.description: Number of births per 1,000 reproductive women (between the ages of 15 to 44) in a specific group. This data is only available for the "15 to 44" age group.

columns.name: Count of Multiple Births
columns.description: Total number of births to twins or higher order multiples

columns.name: Rate of Multiple Births
columns.description: Number of births to twins or higher order multiples per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of First Birth
columns.description: Total number of women who gave birth for the first time. This data is only available for the "All Ages" age group.

columns.name: Average Age of First-Time Mothers
columns.description: Mean age of women who gave birth for the first time. This data is only available for the "All Ages" age group.
